evaluation_charts_enabled.description: Evaluation charts | Add a separate generate_charts task and MLflow Image grid diagnostics? Saves up to 2000 heldout prediction/label rows per evaluated model in MLflow. Includes regression/classification diagnostics, supported model importance, competition comparison or independent model-set reports. Adds Matplotlib; no extra training.

shap_enabled.description: Model explanations | Generate optional SHAP importance and sample waterfall charts using training rows only? Applies to single models, competition candidates and all generated branches; adds training runtime dependencies

shap_max_samples.description: Model explanations | Maximum training rows to explain (1-200). Smaller budgets reduce SHAP computation, especially for ensembles

shap_max_features.description: Model explanations | Maximum transformed features (1-50). This is a guard, NOT top-K selection: exceeding it reports unavailable without computing SHAP

shap_max_display_samples.description: Model explanations | Number of sample waterfalls to save/show (0-50; cannot exceed explained rows). 0 keeps only global importance; enter e.g. 3 for individual explanations
